Reads web pages as Markdown, searches the web, and embeds and reranks text and images.

## API key

1. Open [jina.ai](https://jina.ai/api-dashboard/key-manager) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An API key from the Jina API dashboard.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add jina
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  jina: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Jina AI's [API](https://docs.jina.ai/) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show jina` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** Billed in tokens against the account balance; GET /v1/models lists each model's price.

**Rate limits:** Reader 500 requests a minute, Search 100, embeddings and rerank 500; premium keys get ten times more.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Jina%20AI).
